title: LSM Race Rules 2024 — official race rules PDF (surface, loops, cutoff, DQ, aid, wildlife protocol)
claims: The 21 km loop follows rough dirt roads that undulate across the conservancy; the full marathon runs two loops and the half one loop; the rules state an average altitude of 6,000 ft.
Runners must not deviate from the marked route.

Disqualification applies for a wrong or missing race number, swapping numbers with another runner, deviating from the route, or switching from half to full after the race has started (such runners are stopped at the second-lap junction).
Full marathon runners must have started the second loop by 10:30 AM, three hours after the start.
Water stations are placed every 2.5 km together with bush toilets and first aid posts.
A helicopter is on standby; a Red Cross ambulance waits at the finish with three ambulances around the course; a recovery tent staffed by medical personnel serves finishers.
Walkers keep left and runners keep right on course; bicycles are prohibited; spectators are marshalled by volunteers.
